runtime: All checked-in tests use Go only. Python/Cairo were development-only reference generators; no external reference renderer is required at runtime or during tests.

manim.settings: SVGMobject(should_center=False,height=None,width=None,use_svg_cache=False); call flip(RIGHT) a second time to undo the importer final flip; record original SVG-space bounds and fills. Loaded read-only from the local source via PYTHONPATH with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1.
manim.coverage: Nested use references, inherited/explicit fills, translations, scaling and rotation. No animation comparison is claimed.

raster.coverage: Local nested references, inert nested defs, xlink:href, inline fill precedence, symbol dimensions, nonzero viewBox origins, default aspect-ratio placement, symbols without viewBox and rotated use offsets.

known_reference_differences: svgelements 1.9.6 differs from SVG viewport placement for the nonzero-origin symbol fixture. Symbol placement is compared against CairoSVG, not treated as pinned Manim parity.
CairoSVG 2.7.1 does not apply opacity on the use element as expected in the isolated fixture. Use opacity is covered by explicit pure-Go pixel expectations, not this PNG.

benchmark.workload: Parse and expand a 256x256 user-space SVG with 256 use instances of a two-shape group (512 shapes).
benchmark.image_size: not applicable: importer benchmark; separate raster regression uses 128x96 and 1 frame
benchmark.excluded: No reference generation, rendering, PNG encoding, disk I/O, animation sampling or subprocess execution is timed.
